name: safeagent
description: SafeAgent — AI Industrial Safety & Risk Assessment Agent (Research PoC)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build:pages --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/worker && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
